item.title: MEA market decision-making cycle is fast but risk-averse - TRENDS MENA
item.description: MEA markets feature rapid growth, high owner influence, diverse operator models, and younger hotel infrastructure, says Ralph Melis, co-founder and chief operating officer (COO) of ExploreTECH.

item.description: The most contentious questions remain Hamas's refusal to publicly commit to full disarmament, a non-negotiable demand from Israel, and Israel's lack of clarity over whether it will fully withdraw its forces from Gaza.

item.title: UAE is converting talent, trust, and technology into a Knowledge Nation - TRENDS MENA
item.description: Dr. Lolowa AlMarzooqi, Associate Vice Provost at New York University Abu Dhabi, tells TRENDS that the UAE’s real competitive edge lies in its people and how the country’s approach to talent, leadership, and lifelong learning is shaping its next phase of growth.

item.title: Who has been invited to be on Trump's Gaza boards? - TRENDS MENA
item.description: The White House said there would be a main board, chaired by Trump himself, a Palestinian committee of technocrats meant to govern the war-wracked territory, and a second "executive board" that appears designed to have a more advisory role.
